examples.explanation: Characters 'a' at indices i = 0 and i = 3 are close as 3 - 0 = 3 <= k. Merge them into the left 'a' and s = "abc". No other equal characters are close, so no further merges occur.

Characters 'a' at indices i = 0 and i = 1 are close as 1 - 0 = 1 <= k. Merge them into the left 'a' and s = "abca". Now the remaining 'a' characters at indices i = 0 and i = 3 are not close as k < 3, so no further merges occur.

Characters 'y' at indices i = 0 and i = 1 are close as 1 - 0 = 1 <= k. Merge them into the left 'y' and s = "ybyzybz". Now the characters 'y' at indices i = 0 and i = 2 are close as 2 - 0 = 2 <= k. Merge them into the left 'y' and s = "ybzybz". No other equal characters are close, so no further merges occur.
